name: codex-control-plugin
description: Connects this macOS or Windows Codex device through secure account-based device claiming.

interface.shortDescription: Connect this Codex device to Codex Control.
interface.longDescription: Runs CodexControlPlugin with Codex, creates a key-backed device identity, and lets a signed-in user claim the device through a one-time browser or mobile link.
defaultPrompt: Let me claim this Codex device in Codex Control.
